name: facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/lo.create_logger: create a Logger instance with a log directory path to initialize logging files
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/lo.log_cfg: log configuration parameters as a YAML file using the Logger log_cfg method
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/lo.log_acc: log accuracy metrics as CSV rows using the Logger log_acc method
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/lo.log_loss: log loss metrics as CSV rows using the Logger log_loss method
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/lo.log_ws: log model weights as HDF5 datasets per epoch using the Logger log_ws method

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ma.run_training: run the classifier balancing training pipeline using a YAML config file and dataset
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ma.run_evaluation: run the evaluation of a trained model on a test split with open-set support
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ma.run_knn_testing: run KNN-based classification testing with configurable feature and distance types
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ma.update_config: update a YAML config dictionary with CLI arguments and optional KNN classifier parameters
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ma.split2phase: map a data split name to its training phase name with val-as-train support

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ru.run_model_training: run the model class train method to train a feature extractor and classifier network over multiple epochs
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ru.run_model_evaluation: run the model class eval method to evaluate accuracy on validation or test datasets with shot-based breakdowns
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ru.calculate_centroids: calculate class centroids from training data features by averaging feature vectors per class label
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ru.calculate_knn_centroids: calculate KNN centroids with unnormalized, L2 normalized, and centered L2 normalized variants for KNN classification
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ru.load_saved_model: load a saved model checkpoint including state dict and centroids from a directory path

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ta.run_tau_norm_evaluation: run the tau norm classifier balancing script with argparse to evaluate accuracy across p-norm values
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ta.run_pnorm_normalization: run the pnorm function to normalize classifier weights by a given power p
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ta.run_forward_inference: run the forward function to compute dot product logits for test features using normalized weights
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ta.run_cos_similarity: run the cos_similarity function to compute cosine similarity between two feature tensors
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ta.run_preds2accs: run the preds2accs function to calculate and print many-shot, median-shot, and low-shot accuracy metrics

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ut.init_weights_model: initialize a PyTorch model with pretrained weights from a checkpoint file path
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ut.shot_acc_few_shot: calculate few-shot accuracy metrics split by many, median, and low-shot class thresholds
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ut.logits2entropy_uncertainty: compute entropy from model logits to measure prediction uncertainty for each sample
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ut.get_priority_sampling: compute sample priority weights using score, entropy, or cross-entropy from logits and labels
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/ut.F_measure_openset: calculate F1 score for open-set evaluation with unknown class rejection support
